author: San_David
body:
So...I know this kinda pales in comparison to the other non-donators with Prestige #3 and whatnot, but I feel fairly proud right now. Woohoo, Neb. Prestige #1, with the next coming in 17 years! >.>

And, just a note, I won't actually prestige until I'm in a game with some friends. Mainly because I want to derp around with the jukebox. :D

Also, could a mod please move this to Game Discussion? Sorry about it being in the wrong category...
